notes: Zertal 1996 Site 94 (Khirbet Malih (C); entry grid 1957/1930 is the unit point exactly) describes a flint scatter and scattered stones on a hill by Wadi Malih. It describes no pool, pit or grave, so features is empty. The water source is the river (Wadi Malih) next to the site. Fig. 227 (p. 301) belongs to the Site 92 entry and was supplied only as a cross-reference. It labels an aqueduct, a mill, a dam and buildings, but no pool, pit or grave, and nothing was coded from it. The header field 'Cisterns: none' is recorded as an explicit C2 absence, but it covers cisterns only.
